name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Playback Auto now rejects dead sources before playback, chooses the highest-quality live copy that fits each server's measured or configured WAN capacity, and falls back across duplicate Jellyfin or Plex copies without changing the stable Jellyfin item or its watch progress. Exact per-source bitrate, resolution, container, runtime, Plex native ID, and signed Auto authority remain bound to the selected source.
